page.overview:
Who is Iphiklus?

Iphiklus who was the son of Phylakus and Periklymene was one of two Argonauts by the same name (the other being the son of (Thestius and Leukippe). The exact extent to Iphiklus' involvement is unknown as he is only mentioned by name in the part of the story of the golden fleece where the Argonauts assemble.

Iphiclus, son of Phylacus, by Periclymene, daughter of Minyas, from Thessaly, Jason’s maternal uncle. Category:Argonauts
